title: DarkFall
description: Minecraft Darkfall, constructed with the player in mind from the ground up. Tons of QOL, combat, building and exploration / worldgen mods to challenge and enhance the game, with a few surprises thrown in as well. You've been warned. Try it if you dare.
body:
PLEASE READ THIS PAGE IN IT'S ENTIRETY. **_BELOW IS A LIST OF ALL 377 MODS AS WELL AS THE VERSION #. DO NOT UPDATE ANY MODS OR FORGE_**. ALL MODS HAVE BEEN TESTED TO WORK WELL TOGETHER. PLEASE LET ME KNOW IF YOU FIND ANY BUGS AND I WILL UPDATE AS SOON AS I CAN. THANKS.

The Darkfall modpack was created to be more challenging, adventurous, fresh and fun, all at the same time, from the ground up and with the player in mind.

With the addition of many more mob mods such as _Enderman Overhaul_, _Ultris Boss Expansion_ and _Mob Captains_, _Better Combat_ comes as no surprise to give a more challenging combat system to gameplay. But also, mods like _Tipped Daggers, Spellbound Weapons, Immersive Armors_ and _More Bows Restrung_ adds to your arsenal of ways to defeat these upgraded bosses and baddies. Combat isn’t just harder, it’s more compelling and strategic in the later game. And you will never feel overpowered early on.

And if you like building as much as I do, _Create, Macaw’s, Stoneworks and Revamped Piles_ makes for some incredible builds. There’s also the _Let’s Do_ mod series like, _Brewery, Bakery, furniture and Herbal Brew_ as well as _Cooking for Blockheads_ to make staying alive easier and a little more interesting.

Tons of QOL mods including: _Game Menu Mod Options_ to adjust configs from in-game, _Time Control_ to adjust how long you want the day and or night to be. It’s completely customizable. No more wondering if you dropped or picked up items either. _Loot Beams, Physics and Immersive UI_ will allow you to track exactly what you’ve got and with _Mouse Tweaks and Inventory Essentials_, sorting inventories is a cinch. Speaking of Loot, _Better Dungeon Loot_ will give you that feeling of accomplishment when beating a boss or a dungeon. So, no more string and iron ingots in chests. _Better F3_ lets you see all your world data at a glance and easy to decipher and _Unity: Dark Edition_ gives the UI a little dark flair to complement the game’s atmosphere and with _Cherished Worlds_ you can mark your favorite seeds.

World generation and exploration is enhanced also, to make the Darkfall world come alive. You’ll find _Yung’s content, Spawn Animations, Tectonic, Luki’s Grand Capitals, Guard Villagers, Towns and Towers_ and a host of other structure and exploration mods to create an atmosphere in Minecraft that you’ve never seen before.

There’s also a few surprise mods thrown in Darkfall to give you a sense of mystery and excitement. Nighttime isn’t for the faint of heart. You’ve been warned. Give this modpack a try … If you DARE.!
